paite: Huan ngai in, "Philistia mite'n Keilah khua asual ua, phual a buhte alaksak vek uh," chi in David ahilh uhi.
heading: David In Keilah Khua Ahondam

paite: Huchi in David in, "TOUPA, huai Philistia mite ka va sual diam?" chi in adong hi. TOUPA'N David kiang ah, "Philistia mite va sual inla, Keilah khua va humbit in," achi hi.
David mite'n akiang ah, "Ngai in Judah gam a om nangawn i lau ua, Keilah a hohsuk a Philistia sepaihte va sual lauhuaizaw sem na'n chia," achi uhi.
David in TOUPA adong nawn hi. TOUPA'N adawng a, akiang ah, "Thou inla, Keilah ah hohsuk in, Philistia mite na khut ah ka hon pe ding," achi hi.
Huchi in Keilah ah David leh amite ahoh ua, Philistia mite ava sual ua, agante uh alaksak ua, tamtak athat uh. Huchibang in David in Keilah khomite ahumbitta hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Keilah a David kiang a Ahimelek tapa Abiathar atai lai in siampu puanak tawi in apaisuk hi.
Keilah ah David ahoh chih Saul ahilh uhi. Saul in, "Pathian in ka khut a amah hon pia ahita ve. Kulh kongpi leh akalhna nei khua ah lah lut in akikhumta ngal a," achi hi.
Saul in mi tengteng kidou ding in Keilah khua va sual a David leh amite va um ding in asamkhawm hi.
David in Saul in atung ah thil hoih lou asawm chih a na thei hi. Siampu Abiathar kiang ah, "Siampu puanak hon la dih ve," achi hi.
Huchi in David in, "Aw TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian, kei ziak a khua hihse ding in Keilah ah Saul hong paisuk atum, chih kei na sikha in ka za hi.
Keilah a mite'n akhut ah hon pe ding uam? Na sikha in ka zak bang in Saul ahong paisuk diam? Aw ToUPA, Israelte' Pathian, hehpih in na sikha hon hilh in," achi hi,
TOUPA'N, "Ahong suk ding," achi hi. Huchi in David in, “Keilah khua mite'n kei leh ka mite Saul khut ah ahon pe ding uam?" achi hi. TOUPA'N, "Ahon pe ding uh," achi hi.
Huchi in David leh amite, zaguk hiamtak athou ua Keilah a pan apawt ua, alemna lamlam ah apaita uh. Keilah a pan David ataikheta, chih Saul ahilh ua; huchi in kuankhiak akikhelsakta hi.
David gamdai ah, leikohawm ah a-om hi. Ziph gamdai a tanggam ah a-om nilouh hi. Saul in niteng in amah azong a, himahleh Pathian in akhut ah ape kei hi.
heading: Tanggam Ah David

paite: David in amah thah tum in Saul ahong kisa chih athei a; huchi in Ziph gamdai Horesh ah David a-om hi.
Saul tapa Jonathan athou a, Horesh ah David kiang ah ahoh a, Pathian ah akhut ahatsak hi.
Akiang ah, "Lau het ke'n, ka pa Saul khut in ahong zongkhe kei ding, Israelte tung ah kumpi na hong hi dia, kei nang hon zom pa ka hi ding. Hiai leng ka pa Saul in athei kilkel hi," achi hi.
Anih un TOUPA ma ah thukhun abawl ua, Horesh ah David a-om nilouh a, Jonathan bel a-inn lam ah apaita hi.
Huchi in Ziph mite Gibeah ah Saul kiang ah ahohtou ua, "I kiang ua Horesh a leikohawm, gamdai simlam pang Hakilah mual a David na kibu nilouh akei maw?
Huaiziak in aw kumpipa, hong paisuk na lunggulh lamtak ahih bang in hong paisuk inla, kou ka hih ding uh ahihleh kumpipa khut a amah hon piak ahi ding," achi uhi.
Saul in, "TOUPA'N hon vualzawl hen. Noute'n na hon hehpih mahmah uhi.
Pai unla, va chian nawn sem unla, anung va zui unla, amumi leng va chian hoih nawn sese un. Lepchiah piltak in thil ahih nak chih mi'n ahon hilh uhi.

Huaiziak in abukna mun tengteng thei sipsip unla, ka kiang ah hong nawn ngeingei unla, nou kiang ah kei leng ka hong sam ding hi. Huan hichi ahi ding a, hiai gam a a-om peuhmahleh Judah mi sang tampi lak a pan ka zongkhe ding," achi hi.
Huchi in athou ua, Saul ma in Ziph ah ahoh uh. Himahleh David leh amite gamdai simlam Arabah a Maon gamdai ah a-om uhi. Huai mun Jashimon simlam a om ahi.
Saul leh amite amah zong ding in ahoh uh. David ahilh ua, huchi in suangpi zuan in apawtkhia hi. Maon gamdai ah David adelhta hi.
Saul tang langkhat lam pang ah apai a, David leh amite bel tang langkhat lam pang ah apai uhi. David Saul lau in kintak in atai a; Saul leh amite'n lah David leh amite mat tum in a-umkimvel ngal ua.
Himahleh Saul kiang ah, "Kin meng inla, hong pai in, Philistia mite'n i gam uh ahong sual uh," chi in thangkou ahong tung hi.
Huchi in Saul in David adelh lai akiksan hi. Philistia mite sual ding in apaita hi. Huaiziak in huai mun Sela-hammahlekoth achi uhi.
David huai a kipan apaitou a, En-gedi leikohawm ah a-om hi.
